faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Patent Agent recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Madras Patent Agent recruitment is 26th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Patent Agent post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Registered Indian Patent Agent and possess a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering. A strong technical background is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Patent Agent position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Patent Agent position is Rs. 25,000/- per month, with potential for upward revision based on experience.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Patent Agent post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Patent Agent post at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Patent Agent role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an online application, followed by shortlisting, a test/interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the experience required for the Patent Agent position?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to have 0-5 years of experience in IP-related work.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, where a link to the PDF is provided.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Patent Agent position at IIT Madras is on a contract basis.
